1879064389.Skill_Desc: Allows you to track the presence of nearby beasts and other natural creatures.

1879090245.Skill_Desc: Roar of rage. When is sometimes? Sometimes is next.

1879104837.Skill_Desc: A strong blow from the Defiler's staff.  Contact with a Defiler's staff can poison many denizens of Middle-earth.

1879136965.Skill_Desc: After the defeat of your opponent, you calm down and prepare for your next engagement.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Defeat Response</rgb>

1879138629.Skill_Desc: A sharp blow from the Defiler's staff. May briefly daze the target.

1879146821.Skill_Desc: This fellowship skill does minor direct tactical damage to your target, then more damage over time and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879160005.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Éogar, son of Hadorgar at Hengstacer Farm.

1879212101.Skill_Desc: Instructions: Apply gently, but firmly to target's face. One application per usage. Please see your Minstrel if conditions persist. WARNING: Target must remove all hats, helms, and other headgear for Coveritol to function properly.

1879213893.Skill_Desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.
1879213893.Skill_Name: A Snail out of its Shell (Ranged)

1879217093.Skill_Desc:
A Finishing Skill that deals enormous AoE damage to foes and AoE healing to allies.

 <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879233861.Skill_Desc: The Courser is a lightly armoured War-steed. Fast and agile, the Courser provides the greatest speed and maneuverability on the battlefield, trading Endurance and Armour to retain their nimbleness.

1879242309.Skill_Desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879244869.Skill_Desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, this skill is executed at range.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Lance effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Lancer's Charge.</rgb>

1879245637.Skill_Desc: The slow nature of a flame that consumes is coupled with runes of longevity to bring about a long slow burn on an enemy target. This effect can stack up to three times.

1879246021.Skill_Desc:
You violently stab at your opponent, doing additional damage to enemies wounded by your bleeds.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Ignores 30% of the target's mitigations.

Does 25% additional damage per bleed, which ignores all mitigations.</rgb>

1879250757.Skill_Desc: The Lore-master marks an enemy and allows his allies and their mounts to draw inspiration from fighting the marked foe.

1879257541.Skill_Desc: A powerful toss which aggravates your target, forcing them to attack you.

1879267141.Skill_Desc: You kick out at your enemy.

1879267909.Skill_Desc: The Minstrel sings a song that allows them to instantly reap the benefit of two ballads and unlock their Coda

1879271749.Skill_Desc: Strike the enemy and reflect a portion of their damage back at them.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Retaliation or Whirling Retaliation</rgb>

1879295429.Skill_Desc: Places a snare to slow the enemy and cause damage over time.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879302597.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Oath-bound)

1879304005.Skill_Desc: Your arrow can cause a wound that bleeds.

1879315141.Skill_Desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879357637.Skill_Desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: Bâr Thorenion

1879358789.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879368645.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Crafted from a recipe available for barter from the March on Gundabad Quartermaster.

1879385157.Skill_Desc: Brings out a golden barn owl to keep you company.
1879385157.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879506373.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for Figments of Splendour or in a Steel-Bound Lootbox.
